title: Lam Research Stock Price Down After Analyst Downgrade - National Today
body:
Erste Group Bank cuts Lam Research from buy to hold rating, sending shares lower

Got story updates? Submit your updates here. ›

Shares of semiconductor equipment maker Lam Research (NASDAQ:LRCX) fell 1.6% during trading on Thursday after Erste Group Bank downgraded the stock from a buy rating to a hold rating. The stock traded as low as $208.80 before closing at $218.44 on lower than average volume.

Lam Research is a major supplier of critical wafer fabrication equipment used by semiconductor manufacturers. Analyst downgrades can impact investor sentiment and stock performance, especially for a company that is a bellwether for the overall semiconductor industry.

Erste Group Bank cited unspecified reasons for the downgrade of Lam Research. Several other analysts have maintained buy ratings on the stock, with price targets ranging from $200 to $290 per share. Lam Research's stock has risen significantly over the past year, up around 40%, as the company has benefited from strong demand for its semiconductor manufacturing tools.

Investors will be watching closely to see if the stock can regain its momentum in the coming weeks and months.
